content:
IncidentBot: PAGER — production: streaming p99 spike detected in prod-us-east-1. p99: 7.2s, p95: 1.6s. Affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/chat/stream. Possible streaming stalls/chunking. Auto-page oncall. :rotating_light:
emma: got the page, I'm on it. joining call now.
tim_sre: I see the same in dashboards — sudden tail at ~08:12 UTC. Proxy write latency jumps, backlog on front-proxy queues.
raj_prod: customer reports: intermittent long hangs when streaming replies (SSE). Some sessions time out after 30s. Support ticket #CS-2241 opened.
maria_platform: metrics: proxy 502 rate up ~1.4%. origin worker p95 unchanged but p99 jumped. Suggest checking ALB keepalive and proxy write timeouts.
alice_support: sharing snippet from customer: "client sees spinner for ~20s then connection reset" — region eu-west-1 and us-east-1.
emma: quick checks: curl to /v1/stream with chunked output from internal LB returns first chunk fast but then long pause between chunks. reproducing locally against prod-edge.
emma: running tcpdump on proxy node-42: seeing write stalls on upstream socket. logs show repeated EPIPE when client cancels.
# code block: observed nginx proxy timeout config
```
proxy_read_timeout 30s;
proxy_send_timeout 30s;
proxy_buffering on;
proxy_busy_buffers_size 512k;
```

tim_sre: interesting — proxy_buffering could be building full chunk before flush. Also some clients are slow consumers; that will block worker if we don't flush. Check keepalive and chunk flush intervals.
raj_prod: rolling check: any recent deploys to streaming runtime? deploy-bot: no streaming service deploys in last 2 hours.
maria_platform: check kernel tcp_tw and socket buffer stats. adding helper script to diagnostics channel.
amma (typo): (ignore, accidental)
emma: load on worker pool steady, but KV cache evictions spike correlates with stalls. possible memory pressure causing GC pauses on some language runtime?
tim_sre: which model instances? Looks like larger-seq requests hitting quantized model variant XQ-2. Could be longer decoding time for certain prompts.
raj_prod: customer impact: ~3% of streaming sessions see >10s stall; total user-visible errors ~0.6% since spike started. high-value customers flagged in ticket.
alice_support: escalating to account managers for affected customers. sending status update now.
emma: mitigation plan proposals: 1) enable aggressive chunk flush on proxy (flushes small chunks quickly), 2) temporarily route streaming traffic to slower fallback model variant with smaller decoding steps, 3) apply client-level throttling for identified slow consumers, 4) increase proxy_write timeout from 30s->60s to avoid premature resets while we investigate.
maria_platform: I can bump proxy_write_timeout, but that's bandaid. Also can deploy config to disable proxy_buffering for streaming paths to reduce head-of-line blocking.
tim_sre: sequence for immediate action: A) flip disable buffering for /v1/stream and /v1/chat/stream on prod-edge (canary 1 node) B) route 20% of traffic to fallback model (XQ-1) with lower seq-rate C) add temporary metric alert for per-session chunk-gap >5s.
emma: doing A now — patching nginx config and reloading on canary node. patch: `location /v1/stream { proxy_buffering off; chunked_transfer_encoding on; sendfile off; }`
oncall-bot: Deploy started: nginx-config/streaming-buffer-off -> canary node-7.
emma: canary reload success, smoke curl looks better — chunk gaps reduced to <200ms on canary.
maria_platform: rolling to remaining proxies in 2m.
raj_prod: starting routing change to fallback model for 20% via smart-router. will monitor p99.
# logs: quick tail showing proxy behavior
```
[08:13:22] proxy[node-7] upstream write paused for 12.3s
[08:14:01] worker[XQ-2] decode step 196 slow: 420ms
[08:14:09] proxy[node-21] client slow consumer: socket rcvbuf full
```

tim_sre: after canary roll, edge p99 dropped to 1.8s from 7.2s in canary region. global p99 still at ~4.1s — routing change helping.
emma: increasing proxy_write_timeout to 60s on edge while we validate.
alice_support: update sent to customers — we advised retry and noted temporary workaround to reduce model size on client side. responses look grateful. :thumbsup:
maria_platform: also identified one proxy autoscaler group at capacity — scaling up 2 more instances to reduce queueing.
emma: adding short-term rate-limit on problematic client IP range identified in logs (aggressive slow consumers). implemented 429 backpressure rule for 1m.
raj_prod: monitoring: error rate down to 0.4%, p99 down to 2.3s. still watching.
emma: prepping handoff to next oncall in 30m: summary and actions to continue: - buffering off rolled to all edges - fallback model 20% routing in place - proxy_write_timeout bumped - autoscaler +2 instances - client throttling rule applied - create follow-up eval on XQ-2 decode steps.
oncall-bot: Reminder: next oncall is tim_sre at 5540002000 (in ~32m).
emma: handoff notes posted to /incidents/post-handoffs. Please escalate to infra if p99 > 4s or error rate > 1% after rollback window.
tim_sre: ongoing tasks for follow-up: 1) deep trace on decode step slowdowns (profiling XQ-2), 2) investigate KV cache eviction correlation, 3) consider chunked encoder tweak to force small flushes from worker.
raj_prod: customer impact summary for handoff: affected sessions peaked ~3.2% at 08:14 UTC, total customer-facing errors ~0.6%, primary impact: streaming stalls (perceived frozen stream) in us-east-1 and eu-west-1.
emma: logging a postmortem ticket PM-335 for root-cause and RCA owner assignment.
alice_support: I'll follow up on status emails and collect any repro logs from customers.
maria_platform: leaving scaling and observability tweaks in place for now; will revert proxy_write_timeout after RCA if safe.
emma: thanks all — monitoring looks stable. passing to @tim_sre for next watch. :white_check_mark:
tim_sre: acknowledged, taking handoff. will run the decode profiler at 08:45 UTC and update thread then.
IncidentBot: Incident resolution watch: auto-close in 72h unless updated.
